ev.q: the video game is a card-driven, turn-based, tactical strategy game
each mercenary in Gloomhaven has a unique set of cards that determine all actions
Cards have two sections, a top and a bottom half
that reward the player with gold, perks, or experience
Players assume the role of a band of mercenaries exploring dungeons, killing monsters, and fulfilling quests
can be played in single player or multiplayer formats
mercenaries will level up unlocking new cards or enhancements
